svg.title: Runners: Who Can Run Code, and What It Can Reach
svg.desc: A public repository's fork pull request reaches a persistent self-hosted runner that keeps state and sits inside the network, while ephemeral runners in a restricted group serve only private repositories and are destroyed after each job.
svg.text: Runners: Who Can Run Code, and What It Can Reach
Persistent self-hosted runners plus public repositories is the combination to avoid.
